verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published TFLOPS or TOPS figures for the RTX PRO 6000, with or without precision and sparsity stated. The docs only mention an FP8 Transformer Engine, and a community comment refers loosely to 'AI TOPS' with no number. Neither lets an ML engineer size training or inference from stated tensor throughput.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can size training and inference from published tensor throughput — TFLOPS or TOPS with precision and sparsity stated, not a bare marketing number
